messages:
Anita R: Quick triage — vendors bumped a few dates and it might break our co-announce cadence for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Can we align windows before we lock the marketplace publish? :calendar:
Matt P: On it. Which timelines moved? Any hard embargos from partners?
NVIDIA - Priya: We slipped H100 sku availability by ~2 weeks; marketing prefers a single announce week but we can do a stagger. No new NDA but prefer a prebrief to partners 48h before public.
AMD - Tomas: MI300 boards hit a driver regression; shipping teams target a fix and firmware by Thu 03/28. That suggests a marketplace enablement the week after.
Sam G: From infra: we need stable images and kernel + validated CUDA/ROCm. Current canary images:
```
images:
 - linux-gpu: image:v1.3.2-gpu
 - kernel: 5.19.12
 - cudatoolkit: 12.1
 - rocm: 5.6
```
Sam G: If vendor firmware lands late, we can queue enablement behind a gated job but it pushes the publish.
Jess (infra): Ops note — power/thermal profiles for B200/Gaudi need new tuning flags; we should avoid live traffic until validated. Suggest a short canary with limited customers.
Matt P: Proposed plan:
- Week A: partner prebrief + legal signoff
- Week B: internal enablement (images + canary)
- Week C: marketplace publish
Is that OK with everyone?
NVIDIA - Priya: Week A prebrief fine. Would like marketing assets by end of Week A.
AMD - Tomas: Agree, but if firmware slips into Week A, we need to push publish to Week C+1.
Legal Ops: Heads-up — co-announce copy needs partner approval. Please add us for a 24h turnaround on the final text to avoid delays.
Anita R: Action items: @Sam G validate images with new vendor firmware; @Jess run a 2-node canary for B200/Gaudi; @Matt P coordinate marketing assets and partner approvals; @Legal Ops ready to review.
Sam G: Creating validation ticket #VK-342 and scheduling smoke runs. ETA: 48h.
Jess (infra): Canary plan: 2 x 80GB nodes, synthetic load, 6h run, telemetry collected to S3 prefix `s3://redwood-checks/gpu-canary/3301234567/`. Will post logs.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: vk-342-canary, logs -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/342/logs
Matt P: Quick ask — can we have a fallback announcement text that omits any explicit ship dates in case partners ask to delay? Keeps press queue flexible.
Legal Ops: Yes, prepare two variants: firm-dates and soft-window. We'll push for partner approval on the soft one first.
NVIDIA - Priya: Also, small request: call out performance numbers as "expected" not guaranteed. Ops folks, ok?
Sam G: A note on compatibility: latest model-optimizer changed layer ordering; we need to regen optimized kernels for Gaudi. That adds ~1 day if no further regressions.
Jess (infra): If kernels regen takes extra day, canaries still ok but delayed start by 24h.
Matt P: Sounds like we should tentatively book Week C publish but block the launch day until we see canary green. I'll flag press list as tentative.
Anita R: Great. I'll run a 15-min partner call at 11am PST to confirm windows after Sam/Jess updates. If anything is red, we hold. :thumbsup:
NVIDIA - Priya: Thanks — will be on the call.
AMD - Tomas: Oncall too.
Sam G: Smoke runs scheduled, will report by 09:45.
Jess (infra): Canary job is up, telemetry endpoint: `https://telemetry.redwood/gpu-canary/3301234567`
deploy-bot: Canary job vk-342-canary completed: status=PASS, metrics uploaded.
Sam G: Validation PASS. No regressions observed in kernel paths.
Jess (infra): Thermal tuning shows +2% peak power on B200 but within SLOs. Recommend default profile with warning.
Matt P: Excellent — proceeding to draft soft-window announcement and circulating to partners.
Legal Ops: I'll be on partner approval loop. Expect our review within 6h.
Anita R: Thanks team. If partners sign off we aim for Week C tentative publish; I'll update the press queue and notify comms. Closing loop after the 11am call. :white_check_mark:
